text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally god-tier, right!? Actually, 
I've surpassed that—I'm basically a 
goddess, aren't I~!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's... insanely strong & super mega 
cute!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So you can do it now, right?! You got 
this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day I get m'lady to love me to 
pieces!!
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, full of energy, aren't you? I could 
hear you all the way down the hall.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I came to cheer you on. Do your best, 
Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thanks!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, maybe I should grab some good luck 
off Miracle too!? She's been on a god-tier 
roll lately, right~?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is that... God?

Since her debut this year, K.S.Miracle had 
quickly made a name for herself as a 
rising star in the sprint division. As for 
her greatest weapon—
choice_data_list:
Did she break a record winning her last 
race?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A new record!?!?
choice_data_list:
And winning by four lengths... or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"That's, like, for real super OP! Miracle 
totally sweeps that, no cap!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally get it, though. Her legs are crazy 
fast!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haha, thank you. Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because this speed of mine was given 
to me by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I totally wanna race with Miracle too! 
Like, you running today?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, today might be tough, but... thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll definitely race against 
Helios... And when that happens, let's 
both give it everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw Miracle! Did you already drop by 
m'lady's place?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I went, but... she was so focused 
that I didn't get to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?! ...
choice_data_list:
Let's not go charging in recklessly, 
alright?
Let's not go charging in recklessly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa! No fair figuring it out right away~!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I saw a lot of faces last 
year... But I guess their impressions 
really fade fast, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...It's supposed to be a dazzling, 
brilliant radiance, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always shine 
with the greatest brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I am... Daiichi Ruby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoops, oh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oooohh?! Whaaaat~~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehh, wait up!! Me too—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Probably best not to do that, don'tcha 
think?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bambooo...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She looks super focused, so it'd be bad to 
bother her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Still, looks like they're feeling pretty 
down. Is it really okay to just leave them 
alone?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't look that way to me, though... 
At least for now, she seems to want to be 
left alone."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! Ruby isn't the only 
opponent you have to worry about, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you've gotten stronger than 
before, but the same goes for me...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Keep a close eye on your surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... "Pay attention to me 
too!"?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bamboo~ You're, like, SO into me, for 
realz☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, stop staring so much! I knew it, 
it's true after all~ ☆"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever works! As long as we get a 
hotter rematch than before!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can get my hopes up, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, today I'm transcending miracles 
and gods—I'm full-on Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna make the biggest 
fuss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Then isn't everything completely 
normal?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Basically, yeah☆
